description: The bytes one planar YUV420 (I420) export readback of each size keeps staged, as alpha2-render lays it out (yuv420p_staging_bytes: each plane row-padded to 256 bytes, each plane on a 512-byte placement boundary, and the 16-byte canary), and the bytes of the packed frame the encoder takes from it (the planes without the canary). alpha2-render readback tests and @alpha2-sh/editor estimatedStagingBytes tests both read this file, so a layout change in one fails the other until both agree.
